from csv_utils import parse_csv

def test_production_exports():
    assert parse_csv('name,note\nAda,"ships, safely"') == [['name', 'note'], ['Ada', 'ships, safely']]
    assert parse_csv('name,note\nAda,"said ""go"""') == [['name', 'note'], ['Ada', 'said "go"']]
    assert parse_csv('\ufeffname,team\nAda,Runtime') == [['name', 'team'], ['Ada', 'Runtime']]
    assert parse_csv('# skip\n"# keep",n\nAda,1') == [['# keep', 'n'], ['Ada', '1']]
    assert parse_csv('') == []

def parse_csv(text: str) -> list[list[str]]:
    if text.startswith("\ufeff"):
        text = text[1:]

    rows: list[list[str]] = []
    row: list[str] = []
    field: list[str] = []
    in_quotes = False
    at_line_start = True
    i = 0
    n = len(text)

    while i < n:
        ch = text[i]

        if at_line_start and ch == "#":
            while i < n and text[i] not in "\r\n":
                i += 1
            if i < n:
                if text[i] == "\r" and i + 1 < n and text[i + 1] == "\n":
                    i += 2
                else:
                    i += 1
            continue

        at_line_start = False

        if in_quotes:
            if ch == '"':
                if i + 1 < n and text[i + 1] == '"':
                    field.append('"')
                    i += 2
                    continue
                in_quotes = False
                i += 1
                continue
            field.append(ch)
            i += 1
            continue

        if ch == '"':
            in_quotes = True
            i += 1
        elif ch == ",":
            row.append("".join(field))
            field = []
            i += 1
        elif ch == "\r" or ch == "\n":
            if ch == "\r" and i + 1 < n and text[i + 1] == "\n":
                i += 1
            i += 1
            row.append("".join(field))
            field = []
            rows.append(row)
            row = []
            at_line_start = True
        else:
            field.append(ch)
            i += 1

    if field or row:
        row.append("".join(field))
        rows.append(row)

    return rows
